subject: Benchmark support cost-share proposal for NovaBio RFP
messages:
From: Tom Garcia <tom@novabio.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@novabio.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: evaluation support for RFP bake-off

Karthik / Sara —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. NovaBio is running a tight bake-off against two other providers and the execs want us to run a head-to-head benchmark on 3 representative pipelines (extraction, clinical Q&A, embeddings search) across 2 weeks.

Question: would Redwood be open to a cost-share on credits for the evaluation? We want to avoid spend risk on our side while still running a realistic workload. Our target is ~300k tokens and 125k embeddings over the window. If you can commit to a credit top-up we can agree to a short mutual action plan and share the benchmark artifacts.

Timelines: evaluation starts 11/15, wrap-up 11/29. Procurement will want a short SOW and a billing-safe approach (no surprise invoices).

Attached: evaluation outline (for reference).

—Tom
Tom Garcia
Sr. ML Engineer, NovaBio
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Garcia <tom@novabio.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@novabio.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation support for RFP bake-off

Tom / Sara ,

Really appreciate the clear scope. Were interested and would like to propose a structure that protects both sides: Redwood can provide a one-time evaluation credit of $7,500 (applied as account credits) plus a technical support voucher (5 hours) to ensure model/ops parity during the run. In exchange, NovaBio signs a short MPA (mutual proof agreement) covering data handling, shareback of benchmark artifacts, and a 30-day post-eval feedback call.

Notes: the $7.5k maps roughly to the token/embedding profile you shared on our reference pricing; if you need more runway we can convert to a capped prepaid plan with a committed minimum. Wed like to avoid open-ended billing liabilities so the credits get consumed first and any overage would require pre-approval.

Next steps if that works: Marissa will draft a two-page MPA and Vanessa can coordinate procurement language for the SOW. Can we aim to finalize the MPA by 11/12? Also need confirmation on which SSO/KMS options youll require for secure logs.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom@novabio.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@novabio.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation support for RFP bake-off

All ,

Draft MPA attached (novabio-sow-draft-v2.pdf). I kept the language tight: credit usage applied before any invoice, audit rights limited to the scope of the bake-off, and a 30-day anonymized metric shareback clause. I also included an acceptance checklist and a template for the mutual action plan.

Jordan s note: for discounts beyond the credit we should confirm pricing floor with finance; Ive put a 'finance-approved: pending' marker. Jordan, could you flag if the $7.5k figure needs executive signoff?

Tom / Sara , let us know if the MPA looks acceptable and any SSO/KMS constraints. We can attach the SOW to the DocuSign link in the related_links above.

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Consultant, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T17:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation support for RFP bake-off

Team ,

FYI finance is okay to approve the $7.5k credit and the 5-hour support voucher as long as the MPA includes the billing-safe language Karthik requested. Exec signoff not required for credits at or below $10k per our Q4 policy. Ive updated the MPA metadata (finance-approved: yes) and attached the internal acceptance note to the deal record.

Vanessa , please proceed with the DocuSign package and route to NovaBio procurement; include the os.environ SSO/KMS checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Sales Ops
